title: Integrated Structural and Dynamic Analysis Reveals Destabilizing Effects of KRAS Missense Variants Associated with Lung Cancer.
authors: Mia, Md Sohel; Datta, Bimal Kumar; Akter, Khadija; Das Topu, Tomal Krishno; Shawon, Jamima Mahzabin; Hossen, Faisul; Pranto, Abdur Rahman; Shadhin, Md Saklain Tanver; Tahsin, Nowmee; Qahl, Safa H; Bakhsh, Tahani; Talukder, Md Enamul Kabir
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟分析KRAS错义突变对蛋白动态结构的影响，但对象为KRAS蛋白自身而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: Given the established oncogenic role of KRAS in lung cancer and its predicted regulation by hsa-miR-134 and transcription factors (NCOA4, NR3C2, ETS2), we systematically catalogued genetic variation across the KRAS gene. In this study, we identified 21,598 SNPs, of which 475 were missense (2.19%), 580 were synonymous (2.68%), and 18,093 were intronic (83.77%). In silico prioritization combined with cross-validation in TCGA-LUAD and MSK-IMPACT cohorts identified four high-confidence deleterious variants (G13C, G13D, G60S, G60V), confirming the recurrence of G13C/G13D and highlighting the fully conserved switch II residue G60 as a structurally distinctive candidate. In MD simulations, G60S showed the largest conformational displacement (RMSD  approximately  8-9 A), elevated per-residue flexibility (residues 28-37: 1.90 --> 2.99 A), increased terminal Rg, and reduced hydrogen-bond occupancy, suggesting localized, mutation-specific perturbations within the G-domain. In contrast, G13D maintained near-wild-type dynamics, indicating that functional impairment may not require global structural destabilization. Consistent ensemble analyses (PCA, DCCM, FEL) revealed a dominant single-mode rearrangement for G60S (PC1  approximately  50.8%), a heterogeneous multi-state landscape for G60V, and a restricted low-energy ensemble for G13D, supporting distinct, position-specific mechanisms. Gene-gene and protein-protein interaction analyses linked KRAS to multiple signaling partners, GO and KEGG enrichment analyses associated KRAS with GTPase activity, Rac protein signaling, and the RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT pathways implicated in lung cancer progression. Overall, these findings identify G13C, G13D, G60S, and G60V as high-priority candidates for experimental validation and may inform future strategies for genomic risk assessment and mutation-specific therapeutic intervention in lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 鉴于KRAS在肺癌中已确立的致癌作用及其受hsa-miR-134和转录因子（NCOA4、NR3C2、ETS2）预测调控的机制，我们系统性地编目了KRAS基因的遗传变异。在本研究中，我们鉴定了21,598个单核苷酸多态性（SNP），其中475个为错义突变（2.19%），580个为同义突变（2.68%），18,093个为内含子变异（83.77%）。通过计算机模拟优先级排序并结合TCGA-LUAD和MSK-IMPACT队列的交叉验证，我们确定了四个高置信度有害变异（G13C、G13D、G60S、G60V），证实了G13C/G13D的复发性，并突出完全保守的开关II残基G60作为结构上独特的候选位点。在分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟中，G60S表现出最大的构象位移（均方根偏差（RMSD）约8-9 Å）、升高的逐残基灵活性（残基28-37：1.90 --> 2.99 Å）、增加的末端回旋半径（Rg）以及降低的氢键占有率，提示G结构域内存在局部、突变特异性的扰动。相比之下，G13D维持接近野生型的动力学特征，表明功能损伤可能不需要全局结构失稳。一致的系综分析（主成分分析（PCA）、动态互相关矩阵（DCCM）、自由能景观（FEL））揭示了G60S的单一主导模式重排（PC1约50.8%）、G60V的异质性多态景观以及G13D的限制性低能系综，支持不同的、位置特异性机制。基因-基因和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析将KRAS与多个信号伙伴关联起来，GO和KEGG富集分析将KRAS与GTPase活性、Rac蛋白信号传导以及涉及肺癌进展的RAS-MAPK和PI3K-AKT通路相关联。总体而言，这些发现将G13C、G13D、G60S和G60V确定为实验验证的高优先级候选变异，并可能为未来肺癌的基因组风险评估和突变特异性治疗策略提供信息。
